name: Palworld
description: Palworld is a multiplayer, open-world survival crafting game where you can encounter and collect mysterious creatures called 'Pals'. Fight, farm, build, and work alongside your Pals.

minimum_specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT

recommended_specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT

settings_detail.name: Graphics Preset

settings_detail.why: Native 1080p delivers sharpness at manageable GPU cost.

settings_detail.why: Upscaling mode that boosts FPS while keeping image quality sharp.

settings_detail.name: View Distance
settings_detail.why: Open-world exploration benefits greatly from far view distance.

settings_detail.name: Shadows
settings_detail.why: Shadow quality has a high GPU cost; Medium looks good enough.

settings_detail.name: Textures
settings_detail.why: High textures are VRAM-bound; safe on 4GB+ GPUs.

settings_detail.name: Effects
settings_detail.why: Combat and environment effects stay vivid at High.

settings_detail.name: Anti-Aliasing
settings_detail.why: TAA works well with FSR and keeps edges smooth.

settings_detail.name: Motion Blur
settings_detail.why: Motion blur adds GPU cost with little benefit; most players prefer it off.

settings_detail.name: V-Sync
settings_detail.why: Turn off VSync and use an FPS cap for lower input latency.

settings_detail.name: FPS Limit
settings_detail.why: Caps rendering work and stabilizes frame pacing.
